plan.major: Biology - Wildlife and Wildland Biology Emphasis
plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-11 from the official Southern Utah University 2026-2027 General Catalog (current edition, catoid=28) Biology - Wildlife and Wildland Biology Emphasis program page and its linked official degree map, 'Biology & Biology Education Degree Maps (2026-2027)', 'Wildlife & Wildland Biology (Campus)' tab, last updated/reviewed July 27, 2026. Semester placement is the university's official sample 4-year campus academic plan (SUU Program Maps, 2026-2027), which the source itself labels a guide only; students confirm specifics in Degree Works with a Student Success Advisor. Collected as the BS: the program is a combined BA/BS, the catalog prints a single combined Total Credits, BA/BS Degree: 120, and the map expressly states that students electing the BA take 16 credits of one foreign language, which are not included in the map; the BS version is recorded, following the prior-wave pattern for combined BA/BS programs. Every term's courses sum to the map's printed term total (14/14/15/16/16/16/14/15) and the plan to 120. DISCLOSED CATALOG HEADER ERROR: the catalog prints the Wildlife and Wildland Biology Emphasis Courses as 47-60 credits, but its own listed sub-requirements sum to 51-64 (Chemistry 10-20 + Quantitative 6-8 + Wildlife Biology Requirements 8 + Zoology Requirements 12 + Plant/Botany Requirements 11-12 + Biology Requirements (4000-Level) 3 + Seminar/Workshop 1); the printed Curriculum total of 74-87 credits DOES equal the Core Requirements (23) plus those sub-requirement sums. The plan is recorded at the catalog's printed degree total of 120, which the official map matches exactly, with the header error disclosed here rather than reconciled (Rotor-Wing and Biomedical Science header-error precedent; this differs from the held SUU cases, where the map itself or the catalog degree total failed to reconcile). The map exercises the catalog's options: Chemistry Option 1 (20 credits; the map notes this also earns a minor in Chemistry, and that Option 2 students take 16 chemistry credits with 4 additional free-elective credits and Option 3 students 10 credits with 10 additional free-elective credits), and MATH 1050 College Algebra (4) plus MATH 1190 Introduction to Data Science (3) for the Quantitative Requirements. The map's four generic Plant/Botany lecture/lab rows (4 credits each, 16 total) and two generic Zoology lecture/lab rows (4 credits each, 8 total) total 24 credits across the catalog's Zoology Requirements block (complete 12 credits from the listed lecture/lab courses) and Plant/Botany Requirements block (complete 11-12 credits from the listed lecture/lab courses), which sum to 23-24 credits combined; the rows are recorded exactly as the map prints them, with the catalog's lists carried on the slots, not reallocated between the blocks. The map includes INFO 1010 Information Literacy (1 credit), which is not named in the catalog curriculum. Per the catalog and the map's note, the ETS major field test in Biology must be completed after BIOL 3110 Evolution and before any capstone course; the map prints this as a non-credit row in Fall Year 3, so it is not a course slot in this plan. Per the catalog, all courses must be passed with a C (2.0) or better to count in the major, courses may not be repeated more than two times without instructor approval, and credits over 10 years old may not be accepted for use in the major. Catalog titles are recorded where the map shortens them.

courses.choice_note: Printed in the degree map as 'MATH 1050 College Algebra* (GE Quantitative Literacy)'.
